name: Picked-over liner
text: A passenger liner, stripped long ago by someone in a hurry. They never got as far as the engine room.

outcomes.result: Behind a jammed hatch: a part still in its mounts, and nobody else's name on it.
The hatch was jammed for a reason. The squad gets out with some scrap and a burn or two.

choices.label: Search the galley
choices.result: Sealed rations by the case, still good, or good enough.

choices.label: Leave her
choices.result: The squad looks once round her dark decks and turns for home.
